$comment: Files the canonical .holo validator must accept (valid) or refuse (invalid). rejection-corpus.test.ts runs every file through validateCanonicalSource with surface 'holo'.
$adopted: Written by claude-cowork for its strict layer (holo_strict.mjs, 2026-10-06) and adopted here unchanged, except that unknown-trait.holo moved to acceptedWithWarning. The 'expect' codes are that layer's error contract and stay as documentation; the test asserts a code only where the canonical path emits one (HS1001 for empty.holo, HS1005 for at-without-name.holo).

acceptedWithWarning.$comment: The canonical validator is tolerant about trait names: it accepts this file, and validate_holoscript adds an 'unknown-trait' warning (mcp-server handlers.ts, checked against buildKnownTraitSet()). Whether a strict mode should make an unknown trait an error (the strict layer's HS1006) is still open.
